It uses a humorous and relatable anecdote about preschool teaching to capture the viewer's interest, specifically mocking the overly sweet 'teacher voice' used with children. The high energy and chemistry between the speakers aim to build a connection with the audience and drive them to listen to the full episode released on August 19th.
